title: Right to Protection against Hazardous Goods

content.scenario: A company markets a children's toy that contains toxic materials, posing a risk to the health and safety of children. A consumer reports the issue to the authorities.
content.outcome: The authorities take action against the company, recalling the hazardous toy from the market and imposing penalties for violating the consumer's right to protection against hazardous goods.
